verdict.rationale: Retell's pricing page explicitly states pay-as-you-go starting at $0 with no per-minute contracts, offers a cost calculator/estimator to project monthly cost from key parameters, and gives $10 free trial credit plus free web testing before committing payment. Community discussion also references actual per-minute rate (17¢/min) corroborating usage-based pricing exists. Missing for 10: a single canonical listed per-minute rate in the docs pack itself and independent verification of calculator accuracy.
